title: Page 7
content_zh:
他不该再对她好的……

该对她好的人是浅羽，不是他。

可是他却在这里，看着她在大雨中哭泣而心疼不已……

“你现在到底在干什么？是因为知道浅羽背叛了你而伤心哭泣？还是因为我刚刚的那番话？”齐藤英树淡淡地蹙眉，想起之前她被他骂一顿之后，伤心地在大雨中胡乱狂奔的模样，再听到她刚刚对他所说的话，一股从未成形过的想法突然跃上了脑海——

“舞冬末，你不要告诉我，你爱上我了。”

闻言，舞冬末愕然地仰起脸望着他，完全不敢相信他会说出这句话来。

“当然不是！”她直觉地否认，甚至惊吓地看着他沉下的脸和那双深不见底的黑眸。

听到她很快地否认，齐藤英树说不上心里怪异的感觉是什么，如释重负？还是失落感？

“既然不是，就不要在我面前耍任性。我是你大哥，不是你丈夫，我若对你好，你就说声谢谢，而不是来质问我为什么要对你好，懂吗？”说着，齐藤英树再次对她伸出手。“快起来，不要像小孩子一样赖在地上。”

舞冬末看着他，依然不想理他，可他说的没错，他又不是她老公，而是他大哥，她是在对他耍什么泼？闹什么性子？还大剌剌地问人家为什么要对她好？

舞冬末，你不要告诉我，你爱上我了。

脑海中再次响起他刚刚说的话，心被震动得厉害。

她一直不敢去面对、去承认的……

是不是就是他所说出口的这个事实呢？

她，爱上他了？

她，爱上浅羽的大哥了？

舞冬末怔怔地看着齐藤英树，恍然明白了一点什么，可这份明白却让她的心狂乱无章了起来，完全不知该如何是好。

她呆呆的，齐藤英树干脆直接把伞塞到她手里，弯下身，拦腰直接将她给抱起“啊。”她吓一跳，赶紧抱住他。

齐藤英树淡睨了她一眼。“把伞撑好，不要让我淋到雨。”

闻声，她使力把伞撑得高高的，又去瞧他。

“不要问我为什么要抱你，因为你的膝盖受伤了，正在流血，我对你，绝对没有其他特殊情感，你就放心吧。”

她没问，他自动帮她解惑，省得她费猜疑。

就这样，在这大雨的夜里，两人没有再说话，她一路枕着他的心跳声，脸红心跳地被抱回到自己屋里，直到她的双脚沾地。

“洗完澡记得要处理伤口，真不会，就把丫头叫起来。”说完，他头也不回地转身离开。

想唤他再说些什么，终究没有开口，只是走到门边目送着他离去，直到看不见了，还依然呆呆地杵在那里好一会儿才关上门。

洗完澡套了件睡袍，舞冬末坐在床上，盯着膝盖上小小的伤口看了又看，这才拿药轻轻抹上，用纱布包好黏起来，蜷着身子缩在被窝里，关了灯，闭上眼，要睡，却睡不着。

这一夜，她一直想着他——

齐藤英树。

第10章(1)

周末一大早，齐藤家的厨房里便燃起了炊烟，众丫头都在里头忙着，边忙边闲嗑牙，这是她们生活的乐趣之一。

“听说了吗？二少爷和二少奶奶昨晚甜蜜蜜的呢，噢，羡慕死人了。”揉面团的丫头鼻子都沾上了面粉，笑容很灿烂。

“怎么个甜蜜蜜？谁看见啦？两人恩爱还能让人瞧见？”

“是某个丫头不小心看见的，昨儿夜里不是大雨吗？下得人心慌慌的，那丫头起身上厕所，刚好瞧见二少爷抱着二少奶奶一路走回房呢，是二少奶奶住的屋子，久久都没瞧见人出来过。”

“真的假的？”

“当然是真的！这种事哪能胡诌？”

“就算真的也没什么，人家毕竟是新婚夫妻啊，哪能真阻得了人家恩爱？我说老爷子也真是的，就算二少奶奶年纪轻些，可这时好生养啊，早点抱孙子多好呢，你们说是不？”

“也没人说什么啊，就是羡慕呗，大雨天的两人还这么甜蜜蜜地恩爱着，二少奶奶撑着伞，二少爷抱着二少奶奶在大雨中走着……哇，光想到就很浪漫！”

“谁说不是呢。”

“我看齐藤家很快就可以听到婴儿的哭声了。”

众丫头说着，低低笑了起来。

本是闲话家常的话题，晚些传到了安本香子耳中，却有如晴天霹雳，她不管不顾地冲到齐藤浅羽房里，抓着他便是一顿搥打——

“香子，你干什么你？”齐藤浅羽莫名其妙地伸手抓住她胡乱朝他身上招呼的拳头，本来这几日冷落她、对她感到抱歉的情绪，也都快被她打散了。

“你说，你是不是不要我了？”安本香子气哭了，被他抓着还是死命往他胸膛上打。

“我没有，只是现在的状况你也知道的……”

“我不知道！我不知道！我什么都不知道！”安本香子几欲抓狂地吼着。“我只知道你抱了我，就不应该去抱别的女人……唔……”

他捂住了她的嘴，紧张地低语。“你给我小声点，要是让下人听见了，是想我们一起死吗？还有，我抱谁来着我？你到底在哪听说了什么乱七八糟的话就来凶我一顿？”

“唔……”她想说话，可嘴巴被封住了。

“我放手你保证不乱说乱叫？好好跟我说话？”

她点点头再点点头，齐藤浅羽这才放开捂住她的手，定定地看着她。“说吧，到底是怎么一回事？”

安本香子把从丫头那儿听来的闲话照说了一遍，一双美眸从头到尾都没从齐藤浅羽的脸上移开些许。

齐藤浅羽的表情很诡异，眼底闪闪烁烁的，竟看不清是笑还是怒，反倒提出疑问。“丫头们说我昨天大半夜的，在大雨中抱着冬末走回西院主屋，久久不曾看见有人出来过？她是跑到我西院的主屋门外守着不成？守多久？五分钟？十分钟？半小时？还是一小时？这些臭丫头，是唯恐天下不乱吗？路过不小心看见，也可以编出一大篇文章来？”

“这重要吗？”安本香子莫名其妙地看着他。

齐藤浅羽看了她一眼，点点头。“挺重要，至少比我是不是真的抱着冬末进屋更重要。”

因为那个人根本不是他，若真属实，抱着冬末进屋的人便是大哥了，那进屋多久，是否真的久久没有出来，就比任何事还重要。

他的妻子跟他的大哥……

明明对她无情无爱，听到这些传闻还是会感到不大愉悦，是男人的占有欲？这真的很莫名其妙！

【本段不纯洁的描写已删减，万分抱歉】

大哥、他和冬末之间的关系，是秘密，就算是香子，他也不能轻易开这个口，就算让香子误会，也得认了。

唉，说一个谎，就要有无数的谎来圆，果然没错。

齐藤浅羽看着安本香子，无奈地开始胡诌道：“我只是抱她进屋而已，她之前为了救我伤了身子，昨天在大雨中滑倒，我这个当丈夫的抱妻子回房，照顾一下她，值得你这样对我又打又质问的吗？”

安本香子的眼眶红了，泪又滑下，问他话时，嗓音还哽咽着。“就抱她进房而已吗？什么都没做？”

惹得他叹了又叹，温柔地伸手去抚她的脸。“没有。”

“可我连你抱她进房都不愿！”她呜呜地偎进他怀里哭了起来。“明明我们两个才是相爱的，为什么你一定要娶她？”

“香子……这问题我之前不是跟你说过了吗？她是我的救命恩人……”

“救命恩人就可以巴着你一辈子吗？你又不爱她！你爱的是我啊！不是吗？你说你说——”
content_en:
He shouldn't be nice to her anymore...

It's Qianyu who should be nice to her, not him.

But here he was, watching her cry in the heavy rain and feeling heartbroken...

"What are you doing now? Are you crying because you know Asaba betrayed you? Or is it because of what I just said?" Saito Hideki frowned lightly, remembering the way she sadly ran wildly in the heavy rain after being scolded by him, and then hearing what she just said to him, an idea that had never been formed suddenly jumped into her mind -

"Wu Dongmo, don't tell me that you are in love with me."

Hearing this, Wu Dongmo looked up at him in astonishment, completely unable to believe that he would say these words.

"Of course not!" She denied intuitively, even looking at his sinking face and those bottomless black eyes in horror.

Hearing her quick denial, Saito Hideki couldn't tell what the weird feeling was in his heart, relief?Or a sense of loss?

"Since it's not the case, don't act willful in front of me. I'm your eldest brother, not your husband. If I'm nice to you, just say thank you instead of asking me why I'm nice to you. Do you understand?" Saito Hideki extended his hand to her again."Get up quickly, don't lie on the ground like a child."

Wu Dongmo looked at him, still wanting to ignore him, but he was right. He was not her husband, but his eldest brother. What was she trying to do to him?What's the fuss about?She even asked rudely why she should be nice to her?

Wu Dongmo, don't tell me that you fall in love with me.

What he just said rang in my mind again, and my heart was shocked.

What she has never dared to face or admit...

Is this the fact that he said?

She fell in love with him?

She fell in love with Qianyu's eldest brother?

Wu Dongmo looked at Saito Hideki blankly and suddenly understood something, but this understanding made her heart go crazy and she didn't know what to do.

She was stunned, but Saito Hideki simply put the umbrella into her hand, bent down, picked her up directly from the waist, "Ah." She was startled and hugged him quickly.

Saito Hideki glanced at her lightly."Hold the umbrella, don't let me get caught in the rain."

Hearing the sound, she held the umbrella high and went to see him again.

"Don't ask me why I hug you, because your knee is injured and bleeding. I have absolutely no other special feelings for you, so don't worry."

She didn't ask, and he took the initiative to help her clear up her doubts, saving her from suspicion.

Just like that, on this rainy night, the two of them didn't speak anymore. She pillowed on the sound of his heartbeat all the way, and was carried back to her room with a blushing heart until her feet touched the ground.

"Remember to take care of the wound after taking a shower. If you really don't know how, just wake the girl up." After saying that, he turned and left without looking back.

I wanted to call him to say something, but in the end I didn't speak. I just walked to the door and watched him leave. When I couldn't see him anymore, I still stayed there blankly for a while before closing the door.

After taking a bath and putting on a nightgown, Wu Dongmo sat on the bed and stared at the small wound on her knee. Then she gently applied the medicine on it, wrapped it in gauze and stuck it together. She curled up in the bed, turned off the light, closed her eyes, and wanted to sleep, but couldn't.

This night, she kept thinking about him——

Hideki Saito.

Chapter 10(1)

Early on the weekend morning, smoke started to burn in Saito's kitchen, and all the girls were busy in it, chewing their teeth while doing so. This was one of the joys of their lives.

"Have you heard? The second young master and the second young mistress were so sweet last night. Oh, I'm so jealous." The girl who was kneading the dough had flour on her nose, and her smile was bright.

"How sweet? Who saw it? How can people see the love between the two of them?"

"A certain girl accidentally saw it. Wasn't it raining heavily last night? It was so rainy that the girl got up and went to the toilet. She happened to see the second young master carrying the second young mistress and walking back to the room. It is the house where the second young lady lives. No one has been seen coming out for a long time."

"Really or not?"

"Of course it's true! How can you make such nonsense?"

"Even if it's true, it doesn't matter. We are newlyweds after all. How can we really stop others from loving each other? I said it's true, old man. Even if the second young lady is younger, it's easy to have children at this time. It would be great to have a grandson as soon as possible, don't you think?"

"No one said anything, they were just envious. The two of them were still so sweetly in love on a heavy rainy day. The second young mistress held an umbrella, and the second young master held the second young mistress while walking in the heavy rain... Wow, just thinking about it makes me very romantic!"

"Who says it isn't?"

"I think the Saito family will hear the baby crying soon."

The girls said and laughed softly.

It was a common topic for gossip, but when it reached Koko Yasumoto's ears later, it was like a bolt from the blue. She rushed into Saito Asaba's room regardless, grabbed him and beat him -

"Xiangzi, what are you doing?" Saito Asaha inexplicably stretched out his hand to grab the fist she was throwing at him randomly. The mood of neglecting her and feeling sorry for her in the past few days was almost broken by her.

"Tell me, do you not want me anymore?" Xiangzi Yasumoto cried angrily, but even when he grabbed her, she beat him on the chest.

"I didn't, but you know the current situation..."

"I don't know! I don't know! I don't know anything!" Yasumoto Xiangzi roared almost crazy."I only know that if you hugged me, you shouldn't hug other women...well..."

He covered her mouth and whispered nervously."Please keep your voice down. If the servants hear it, do you want us to die together? Also, who am I holding? Where on earth did you hear some nonsense and come to beat me up?"

"Well..." She wanted to speak, but her mouth was sealed.

"I'll let you go and you promise not to talk nonsense? Talk to me properly?"

She nodded again, and then Saito Asaha let go of the hand covering her and looked at her steadily."Tell me, what's going on?"

Koko Yasumoto recounted the gossip she heard from the girl, her beautiful eyes never moving away from Saito Asaha's face from the beginning to the end.

Saito Asayu's expression was very strange, his eyes were twinkling, and he couldn't tell whether he was laughing or angry. Instead, he asked questions."The girls said that I walked back to the main house in the west courtyard in the heavy rain with Dongmo in my arms in the middle of the night. I haven't seen anyone come out for a long time. Did she run to the door of my main house in the west courtyard and guard it? How long? Five minutes? Ten minutes? Half an hour? Or one hour? Are these stinky girls afraid that the world will not be in chaos? If you accidentally see it when passing by, you can compile a large article?"

"Is this important?" Xiangzi Yasumoto looked at him inexplicably.

Saito Asaha glanced at her and nodded."It's quite important. At least it's more important than whether I really carry Dong Su into the house."

Because that person is not him at all. If it is true, the person who entered the house with Dong Su in his arms is the eldest brother. Then how long he has been in the house and whether he has not come out for a long time is more important than anything else.

His wife and his eldest brother...

Although he obviously has no love for her, he still feels unhappy when hearing these rumors. Is it a man's possessiveness?This is really baffling!

[The impure description in this paragraph has been deleted, I am extremely sorry]

The relationship between the eldest brother and him and Dongmo is a secret. Even Xiangzi can't open it easily. Even if Xiangzi misunderstands it, he has to admit it.

Alas, telling one lie requires countless lies to cover it up. It is indeed true.

Saito Asaha looked at Koko Yasumoto and began to rant helplessly: "I just carried her into the house. She hurt her body trying to save me before and slipped in the heavy rain yesterday. As a husband, I carry my wife back to the room and take care of her. Is it worth your beating and questioning?"

Yasumoto Xiangzi's eyes were red, and tears fell again. When she asked him, her voice was still choked with sobs."Did you just carry her into the room? Didn't you do anything?"

It made him sigh again and again, and gently reached out to touch her face."No."

"But I don't even want you to carry her into the room!" She snuggled into his arms and cried."Obviously we two are in love, why do you have to marry her?"

"Xiangzi...haven't I told you this before? She is my savior..."

"Can the savior just hold you for the rest of his life? You don't love her! It's me you love! Don't you? You said you said -"
